title: Issued and available UK amateur radio callsigns (Ofcom-published CSVs for response 756622)
dataVintageNote: from the published filename; header and row count exactly match the 2019-08-12 requester annex (141,295, incl. the Licence Issued Dat column - a claim that the column was absent from the annex was corrected on verification review 2026-07-08), so likely the same snapshot re-serialised as CSV for publication

relatedEntries.relation: requester-channel entry for the same FOI response; the published register CSV shares the annex's exact header (incl. Licence Issued Dat) and 141,295-record count - the annex, six days earlier, is the earliest bulk disclosure of per-callsign issue dates
